verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch documents a programmatic path: official language clients, creating an index mapping and then ingesting and querying, indexing data and running searches from your preferred language, a one-line CLI local setup, an official MCP server, and official skills for AI coding agents. The evidence does not show that every step (index creation, document ingestion, querying) runs end to end through the MCP server or CLI without a dashboard. Getting started also points to signing up for a serverless project, which may require the UI, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the MCP server or CLI can create indices and add documents, documented dashboard-free account/project provisioning, a published machine-readable API spec, independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can create an index, add documents, and run queries end to end — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching a dashboard

citations.quote: All you need to do is create an index mapping to start ingesting, embedding, and querying data.
